allow: Squash-merging a pull request into the `alpha` branch of akgngr/verein-erp via `gh api -X PUT repos/akgngr/verein-erp/pulls/<n>/merge -f merge_method=squash -f sha=<head>` is pre-authorized by the repository owner when the PR targets `alpha`, is not a draft and its required checks (`Quality gate`, `Promotion policy (alpha)`) are green on the head SHA. Merging into `beta` or `main` is NOT authorized.
Updating a PR branch with `gh api -X PUT repos/akgngr/verein-erp/pulls/<n>/update-branch` is pre-authorized by the repository owner.
